d:
The Ghost Adventures crew ventures into locations with disturbing histories, reported paranormal encounters and mysteries that refuse to settle. As they investigate unexplained activity and examine the evidence captured during their investigations, every discovery brings fresh questions. Strange voices, chilling encounters and unexplained events leave the team searching for answers, but will the evidence finally reveal what's happening, or will some mysteries remain unsolved?
Watch Ghost Adventures, Season 11, Episodes 12, 5, 7, 3, 13, 8 and 11, on Discovery Channel India.
